description: Revises, shares, revokes, claims, or deletes an anonymous report and exposes a privacy-limited public snapshot query.
authScope: opaque anonymous report-owner token; public share reads use an opaque share token
migrationNotes: Run Confect codegen before wiring generated refs.
Persists append-only evaluationReportVersions and hashed-token evaluationShares.
Public queries return only publicSnapshotJson and never answers, owner tokens, session identifiers, or private report internals.
